snippet.title: Neverbound Pre-Alpha Montage #1
snippet.description:
🃏Wishlist Neverbound on Steam → https://store.steampowered.com/app/4744350/Neverbound/
A grimdark 4-player party strategy game where dark fairy-tale legends collide. Think psychological horror meets Mario Party, with the narrative depth of Hades and Baldur's Gate 3.

Follow us for concept art, lore drops, and dev updates:
📸 Instagram → https://www.instagram.com/neverbound_game/
🐦 X → https://x.com/neverbound_game

💬 Discord (join the playtest) → https://discord.gg/uFNyeMM8N
